snippet.title: Blastlane Racers Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Blastlane Racers is a fast-paced top-down combat racer inspired by classic arcade chaos.
Race across 24 handcrafted tracks, upgrade your car between races, and battle your way to victory with weapons and skill.

Play solo, challenge your friends in 4-player splitscreen, or take the competition online (coming soon).

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4398020/Blastlane_Racers/

Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4986310/Blastlane_Racers_Demo/

Music: "Synergy (Cinematic Rock)" by Infraction (licensed via InAudio)
